scientific_integrity: The published piecewise quadratic invariant and special inverse-integer-angle periodicity are cited as prior work; all-parameter exact rotation fraction and deductions are the assessed contribution. Numerical verification is supplementary and does not prove universal assertions. No independent mathematical review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only tropical real-valued mutation M(s,t) with p,q>0 and pq<4; no corresponding theorem for nontropical maps or pq>=4. No claim of planar Lebesgue ergodicity. Priority caveat for unindexed equivalent calculations.
title: Exact rotation number and full orbit classification for tropical rank-two mutations
